summary: Frontend E2E testing of the new 'Programa Empresas' feature. All 7 flows passed: (1) VIP sees the company request card and CTA on /dashboard/profile; (2) dialog opens, password-mismatch validation disables submit and shows company-password-mismatch; (3) submitting a valid payload with a unique email + E.164 phone succeeds, toast fires, dialog closes, and card transitions to 'En revisión' (company-request-status-pending); (4) admin at /admin/users?tab=company-requests sees the pending row with account email, phone, taxid and address (no password_hash leaked); (5) Approve creates a NEW empresa account (verified via DB: role='empresa', account_status='under_review', parent_user_id=user_test_vip01) while VIP's personal role remains 'vip'; (6) Normal user rejection flow works — card shows 'Rechazada' with admin note and cooldown notice (company-cooldown-notice, 7 días); (7) Permission gate: client GET /api/admin/company-requests returns 403.
critical_code_review_comments: RequestCompanyCard & AdminCompanyRequests are clean, with data-testid coverage for all interactive elements and status badges. Permission 403 handled server-side correctly.
RequestCompanyDialog uses client-side validation that mirrors backend regex (E.164, email, >=8 chars); submit button is correctly disabled when any field invalid.
Admin table never renders password hash — DB stores it but API response excludes it (verified: no $2b$ or password_hash in rendered HTML).
seed_data_creation: Re-ran /app/backend/scripts/seed_test_users.py; created transient company_requests + empresa users then cleaned both collections at end of run (parent_user_id in user_test_vip01/user_test_normal01).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working end-to-end. If retesting, remember to use UNIQUE account_email and UNIQUE E.164 company_phone each run — backend enforces uniqueness. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + fixed wait (SSE keeps networkidle open).
